notes: Checked against Wiktionary:Copyrights and the Wikimedia Terms of Use: entries are CC BY-SA 4.0 (and GFDL), which allows commercial use, so an app may show a definition with the credit in attribution; the same share-alike and change-note rules as Wikipedia apply. Wiktionary's own summary reads share-alike more widely than the licence does ("your materials have to be licensed under the same, similar, or compatible license"); the licence's own text, not that summary, binds. tools/ref.mjs doesn't reach it, so the bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
